original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target literally with target-selection.json/full_target and problem.md:19-48: the approved fixed-q perturbation support interpretation, all positive times, Euclidean/Frobenius normalization, and the separate requirements of integrability and differentiability are retained. H001-H006 extract exactly dimensions, joint smoothness, |q|=1, unit constraint, pointwise existential normality without regularity of its scalar, and locally time-uniform compact support. H003 remains explicitly present and unused; no use of |q|=1 is needed once the constant-q support condition is given. Natural-number dimensions with H001 are the same positive integer dimensions. D001-D003 define the open domain and component derivatives/Laplacian; the zero extensions in D002 are only native total-function views, never smoothness claims across t=0. D004 preserves the exact energy density. D005 uses a total integral convention without assuming finiteness; N002 and R003/S004 prove it is the actual finite Lebesgue integral at every positive time. D004/D005 have H002 guards, available directly in each consuming inference. D006 fixes standard product Lebesgue normalization, including dimension zero, and D007 fixes the real dot product. Principal sources M001-M014 were actually probed in the pinned library and their defining source passages read: the selected M003 is the filter dominated-convergence theorem, and the selected M006 is integral_prod_symm (not the earlier exploratory declarations). All restatements include their native structures/premises: real/complex-like scalar restrictions for inner derivatives, minSmoothness for symmetric derivatives, open-domain smooth derivative loss, countably generated filter, finite-on-compacts measure, s-finite Fubini measures, complete FTC codomain, extended-norm finiteness and interval compactness structures. No external E is selected; the Evans quotation is task provenance, not a borrowed theorem. The graph has exactly R001→N001, R002→N002, R003→N003, R004→N004, R005→P, with every selected M and every N in P's AND closure. The route of problem.md:52-159 is preserved, including the explicit scalar equation comment, common compact box, mean-value bound, dominated-convergence limit, coordinatewise FTC/Fubini, cancellation, and constancy. No material proof passage was omitted. The current structural check is not mathematical certification; these are same-author findings after reading all five actual conditional packets.
